articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
The era of generative AI has kindled an era of generative AI witchhunts. It's routine right now for videogame developers to fend off accusations of using the technology, even when they are full-throated in their disapproval of ChatGPT, Claude and their ilk. Recent examples include Sandustry, the 2D factory builder from Hooded Horse with strangely haunting physics, and the just-announced Humankind 2, whose creators Amplitude have rushed to assure players that their announcement trailer is genuine live action film.
The conversation reflects a shifting idea of what AI-generated imagery 'looks like' - shifting because, strictly speaking, AI-generated imagery has no fixed style or quality. It's derived from whatever data the model is 'fed'. The confusion is exacerbated by the fact that the technology is changing, with new or updated buzzwordy tools being added to the pile. Established hallmarks of generated imagery go out of date fast. Meanwhile, generative AI's richest advocates often muddy the waters, conflating tools and framing their capabilities in ludicrously open-ended, investor-baiting terms. Still, some responsibility falls on regular users who've become accustomed to chucking around claims of "AI slop".
 Read more
articles.title: "Hopefully a meteor will strike the earth soon": Game devs talk genAI witchhunts and the importance of honing your visual literacy

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Attention, dusty creeps who want to play poker with the Wickerman! I found one, a videogame you might enjoy. That game is Hillthorn, a spooky investigative cardgame from Fool Moon and Finnegan Motors - the latter also known for beaming corpo thriller Inhuman Resources: A Literary Machination.
Hillthorn is the story of a detective hired to investigate a disappearance at a secluded mountain community. One of the first things you do, after hassling a worryingly stained forest ranger for directions, is cross a line of salt on the trail. Seems like something a person familiar with the occult would avoid doing, but you are a Private Eye, armed with logic and cynicism. Besides, all of this is presented via the medium of cards. Who's afraid of cards? What are they going to do, give you a paper cut? Ouch! Oh, maybe don't bleed on the salt.

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Infamously simulation-heavy colony builder Dwarf Fortress is getting a Myth and Magic update that, at the possible risk of being maybe a touch hyperbolic, threatens to make all other fantasy game spellcraft look like a sleepy bout of Got Your Nose. It's summarised by Bay12 co-founder Tarn Adams as a set of procedural systems "that go beyond combining spell effects... straight to the fundamental cosmological makeup of the universe", allowing for "magical situations that you cannot get any other way."
 Read more
articles.title: Dwarf Fortress is getting the mother of all magic updates, extending to "the fundamental cosmological makeup of the universe"

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
After an entire decade without a proper new Silent Hill game, in the past three years we've had two completely new games (one of which was pretty damn good if you ask me), one remake, whatever Ascension was meant to be, and the laughably bad new film. A mixed bunch, to be sure, but food is food, and Silent Hill lovers have been starving for more. We're a month away from the next game in the horror series releasing, Silent Hill: Townfall, and according to the franchise's producer, you can expect new games pretty often.
 
Read more
articles.title: Oh lord, Konami want yearly Silent Hill games alongside vaguely described "experiences," just don't let that be another movie

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
With The Expanse: Osiris Reborn proving lacklustre in the hands, I'd say Archetype's time-dilating space RPG Exodus is currently closest to the much-coveted status of unofficial Mass Effect 5. The developers have dropped a release date - 7th April 2027 – alongside a new trailer which digs into the backstory of a super-intelligent octopus sniper, Salt, who fights in a mech.
 Read more
articles.title: Exodus will likely win the Mass Effect spiritual successor war, thanks partly to its Cool Octopus, but I think it has a boring hero problem

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
What's that coming through the hiss and crackle of static? It's a transmission from the Gamescom zone, where a trio of RPS survivalists are fighting to stay alive amid all manner of hazards. You don't want to know the things they've told us about the loos. One of them, James, has ended up hunkered down in the same room as Stalker 2 devs GSC Game World and had the chance to ask them what's in store for the game now its 2.0 update and Cost of Hope expansion are out. The answer is a "different" second DLC and a free multiplayer mode the studio insist won't just recycle mechanics seen elsewhere.
Read more
articles.title: "We're not doing something that everyone [would] do": After Cost of Hope, Stalker 2 devs are working on multiplayer which won't be "session-based" like Counter Strike

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
When I sat down to play Road Kings in April, the event organisers were very clear: when you're done driving around in the sandbox, let us know and we will load up the disaster movie scene. After fifty minutes of my hour with Saber's spin on American Truck Simulator, I'd completely forgotten about the second mission. I was merrily absorbed in hauling truckloads of exercise bikes between the cities of South Georgia and Northern Florida.


Saber are definitely playing catch up with SCS Software. The latter's American Truck Simulator released over a decade ago and it now features nearly half of North America. Naturally, Road Kings will ship with a much smaller map and roster of vehicles. Though Saber hope to pull ahead by injecting a little drama.

 
Read more
articles.title: Road Kings is sometimes American Truck Simulator in a disaster movie, but delivering crates of ellipticals is fun too

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
As revealed earlier this week alongside a look at next year's Songs of the Past expansion, The Witcher 3 is getting a free remastered update next month. As with 2022's next-gen update, some of its tweaks and additions are the work of modders, with the creator of The Witcher 3's HD Reworked Project having revealed that they got the call to collaborate with CD Projekt Red again.
Read more
articles.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered includes work from a top modder, as CD Projekt Red follow the path they walked with the RPG's next-gen update

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
If you think the protagonists of Grand Theft Auto 6 look dull as piping hot ditchwater then rejoice, friend, for the game will let you transform these gung-ho sex magnets into weary and despairing zombies, tottering along the shore of Leonida with eyes like sandy latrines and skin like forgotten cheese.
 Read more
articles.title: GTA 6 life simulation elements confirmed: thank god, we can turn the offensively hot Jason and Lucia into exhausted slobs like the rest of us

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
This week we got our first proper look at Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons, Wizard of the Coast's new RPG-tinted action game. In theory, it's the story of a grizzled weapon master who is searching a lawless pocket dimension for somebody precious to her, but I disapprove massively of this objective, because it sounds like it's going to get in the way of unearthing weird spells and making a glorious mess.
Created by a team of former Far Cry, Watch Dogs and Splinter Cell devs, Warlock gives you an open world full of charms, cantrips and conjurations to gather and fool around with. I'm really hoping it's as open-ended as they're making it sound. Here's a video, followed by some commentary from creators Invoke.
 
Read more
articles.title: New D&D RPG Warlock is an open world spell-collecting game with a touch of Far Cry, and that's just fine by me, actually

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
For a series about light and dark, it's appropriate that Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is a spinoff that's trying to escape the main entries' shadow. Developer Asobo Studio have dropped much that is familiar to explore exactly what a Plague Tale story can be.
Resonance doesn't feature series protagonists Amicia and Hugo. It is set 16 years before the events of the last game, long before the siblings flee across wartorn medieval France, hunted by the soldiers of the Inquisition. In Resonance, you play Sophia and see how she became the woman who saves Amicia in A Plague Tale: Requiem. You learn how, as a child, she was kidnapped by the Inquisition and injected with a poison that gave her visions of a strange island. How her father, the leader of a group of smugglers, found the island and died there searching for treasure and a cure to Sophia's dreams. And how Faro, her father's successor, continues visiting the island, seeking to unearth its secrets.
Resonance's early chapters see a now teenage Sophia growing frustrated with Faro. The smuggler leader never takes her with him to the island, despite – and because of – the mounting casualties in the expeditions. Guiltridden, Sophia stops sharing her visions. Those chapters also teach you Resonance's focus: combat.
Read more
articles.title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy review – a competent action game spinoff that loses what made its predecessors unique

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Since the persistent rumours of a cheeky extra DLC for The Witcher 3 turned into confirmation from CD Projekt Red that such a thing is on the way prior to The Witcher 4, there's been a nagging voice in the back of my mind. On one hand, Songs of the Past is more of an RPG I love, the kind of unexpected gift it seems foolish to have reservations about getting a decade and change on from release. On the other, The Witcher 3 in its current form has long felt like as close to the ideal complete package as you can get.
Going into last night's opening salvo of Gamescom, I was expecting that the DLC's full reveal might dispel my concerns, getting me fully on board with the idea that, yes, Geralt does need one last ride before Ciri takes over going forwards. Instead, I'm still in two minds.
Read more
articles.title: I'm still not convinced The Witcher 3 Songs of the Past is worth pasting over the perfect ending that was Blood and Wine

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Rockstar Games have put out a statement publicly acknowledging the ongoing GTA 6 leaks for the first time. Though they and parent company Take-Two have already gotten the ball rolling on hunting down the leaker, the studio had stayed silent in terms of public-facing comms up until now.
Read more
articles.title: Rockstar finally break silence on "heartbreaking" GTA 6 leak, say it's "unfortunate that the intended game experience may now be impacted by some spoilers"

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
This week, RPS took the downright heroic step of declining to live report on the latest Geoff Keighley trailer bonanza at Gamescom 2026's Opening Night Live. Under the wise guidance of editor-in-chief Julian "Walks Away From Omelas" Benson – and with the honourable exception of Oisin "Looking At Omelas Through A Telescope" Kuhnke, who was on regular evening freelance newswriting duty - we experimented with viewing the showcase as you ordinary humans do, partly because we've recently found that the returns aren't worth the effort of staying at our desks. Some of us may have even streamed the showcase in bed! Like wild beasts!
 
Read more
articles.title: D&D, LEGO, and mounting ennui: Our biggest games from Gamescom 2026

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
Heroes of Might & Magic is having a moment. Not only are publishers Hooded Horse and Ubisoft backing the development of Unfrozen's Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era, the first new game in the series in more than a decade, but Ubisoft have revealed they're completely remaking the series' best-regarded entry: Heroes of Might & Magic 3.
While there are many quality of life improvements in the remake, Ubisoft aims to keep its spirit as close to the original as possible. There is a new three-mission prelude to get you into the story and teach you the game's systems but, after that, you're into the thick of the original campaign and its two expansions – Armageddon's Blade and The Shadow of Death. This also means you'll have all nine factions to play with.
I've played the remake for a few hours already and I'll get into my thoughts on that in a moment. But, the most telling thing about the remake is that it supports all the custom maps and campaigns players have made for the past 25 years. Ubisoft showed how you can import any original map file into Might & Magic 3 Remake's map creator and it will build a modern-looking level from the old data. It's a wonderful way to support the Heroes of Might & Magic 3 players who are still playing decades on from its release.
Read more
articles.title: I'm not a fan of Heroes of Might & Magic 3, but I can recognise that Ubisoft have done a faithful job of recreating the much-loved turn-based strategy RPG

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
Since I’m apparently now RPS’ Radioactive Eastern Europe correspondent, I recently spent a couple of hours in Metro 2039, the gloom ‘n’ grit FPS sequel that Ukrainian developers 4A Games have explicitly styled as a return to the series’ roots. From what I’ve played, it is in fact as much of a hybrid as the mutated shrimp-insects that lurk in its Moscow sewers, reviving the claustrophobic tunnel dwelling of Metros 2033 and Last Light while keeping a few favoured twists from the more freely-roamable Metro Exodus.
Read more
articles.title: Metro 2039's return to the underground plays like the sneaky FPS you'd expect, but there are still good reasons to leave the beaten track

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Hey kid, you want a free remaster? It's totally not a scam! No, really. While everyone knew The Witcher 3's sort of surprise new expansion Songs of the Past would be getting a look-in at Geoff: German Edition, CD Projekt Red had another surprise up their sleeve in the form of a full-on remaster of The Witcher 3, which is coming as a free update next month.
 
Read more
articles.title: CD Projekt Red sweeten the Witcher 3 Songs of the Past honeypot with a free base game remaster, and, oh yeah, both original expansions too

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
The idea behind Humankind is a funny one, in that it pulls from real-world history to essentially let you craft historical fanfiction. I suppose that's true of many strategy games, but this one's all about mixing and matching different cultures throughout history. And now, it's asking you to do so all over again, as a sequel in the works. Zero points for guessing what it's called, because it's very plainly titled Humankind 2.
 
Read more
articles.title: Imbricate human history all over again and throw climate change into the mix in Humankind 2, which arrives 2027

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
You probably don't need me to recap the difficult life Cities: Skylines 2 has had since hitting the streets in 2023. Plagued by performance issues and prompting questions over whether its additions made it a worthy sequel right out of the gate, thus followed years of tweaks aiming to undo the damage. Eventually, original developers Colossal Order handed over the game and series' reins to Iceflake Studios, with Paradox Interactive staying on as publishers.
The latter two have now revealed the next game in the Skylines series - a brick-built city builder dubbed Lego Skylines. It's not a bad name, but surely they could have gone with Lego Cities.
Read more
articles.title: Having taken over Cities: Skylines 2's resurrection, Iceflake Studios are also making a bricky city builder called Lego Skylines

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Following leaks earlier in the week, Crusader Kings 3 and Hearts of Iron IV creators Paradox Interactive have officially announced Afterworld, a post-apocalyptic grand strategy game about wasteland tribes jostling for dominance of a procedurally generated North America. It's Paradox Development Studio's "first non-historical setting in a decade", in the words of game director Dan Lind.
 
Read more
articles.title: Crusader Kings devs Paradox officially reveal Afterworld, a Fallout-flavoured grand strategy game in which you can overrun America with a cannibal cult

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
Ubisoft have done the sensible thing and turned Rainbow Six into a turn-based tactical game. Nabbing the special ability-laden operators of Rainbow Six Siege and dropping them into the XCOM: Chimera Squad framework. The Mario + Rabbids developer have found a spin off that looks to be a natural fit for the series.
Read more
articles.title: Rainbow Six Tactics transforms the demolition-driven Siege into a turn-based game while keeping the destructible environments, operators, and reconnaissance drones

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
You might be surprised to hear this given the very indie vibe about it, but Penguin Colony features RTX. It's actually AAA too, and includes DLSS as well. Perhaps most shockingly of all, there's genAI in Penguin Colony. It's true! It's all true! You can see it in the game's latest trailer for yourself. Look, right there, RTX: Real Terror eXploration. And there's GENeral Antarctic Isolation, Does Lovecraft Still Scare, and Ancient Abomination Awakens to boot! Is your brief heart attack over now? Yes, this is all a tongue in cheek ploy to get you to recognise that the next game from the devs behind Umurangi Generation has a release date.
 
Read more
articles.title: Cosmic horror and sea bird waddling sim Penguin Colony gave me a genAI fright in its release date trailer, but thankfully there's no actual cause for concern

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
It continues to both amaze and concern me that a whole other internet ecosystem appears to exist within the realm of Roblox. Recently, a game by the name of Steal an Egg has blown up on the UGC platform, which is more or less what it says on the tin: you need to steal an egg. This is Roblox we're talking about, however, so Steal an Egg comes with a big ole asterisk that comes in the form of a treadmill you can train on whereby you can doomscroll through TikTok videos.
 
Read more
articles.title: Roblox put a stop to games that include rewards for endless, TikTok-style scrolling, if you're under the age of 16 anyway

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Today, August 25th, Nvidia have released Ray Reconstruction for DLSS 4.5, with the aim of more swankily rendering ray-traced/path-traced shadows and lighting than was possible with previous Ray Reconstruction versions.
Read more
articles.title: Nvidia DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction, out now, ups shadow quality and more accurately illuminates trash bags

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Alongside releasing Ray Reconstruction for DLSS 4.5, Nvidia have announced that their ACE tech best known for powering PUBG: Battlegrounds' generative AI team mates will be coming to another game early next year. Said game is Aniimo, a creature-catching open-world RPG from Chinese devs Pawprint Studio, which looks to be following the legally distict Pokemon-like formula established by the likes of Palworld. With help from the Nvidia tech, it'll also let players chat with their creatures.
Read more
articles.title: Nvidia tech behind PUBG's genAI team mates will let folks chat to creature-collecting RPG Aniimo's not-Pokemon next year

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Clear River Games Development and Limited Run are working on a PC re-release of Terranigma, Quintet's Super Nintendo Entertainment System action-RPG from 1995. I never played Terranigma, for I was raised according to the Holy Maxim that Sega do what Nintendon't. I would sooner have flushed my own blast processor down the toilet before I permitted any associates of Mario under my roof.
RPS guides writer Jeremy did play Terranigma, however, and says it's one of his favourite games ever. For the sake of collegiality, I guess I'll suppress my emaciated console war impulses and take a look. Gosh, this is a pretty trailer.
 
Read more
articles.title: 31 years later, beautiful SNES RPG Terranigma is finally coming to PC, and I must lay the ghost of my console warrior childhood to rest

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Last week, Rockstar Games' parent company Take-Two were filed subpoenas asking for info from Microsoft and Discord to help uncover the identity of the hacker or hackers behind the ongoing GTA 6 leaks. With clips of the game continuing to hit the net and the potential threat of story spoilers starting to drop soon, it was an understandable request for the company to have made, even if questions could be raised about the amount of data it might give them access to.
One of the two companies subpoenaed, Discord, have now said that as of last night they've yet to be served with any subpoena from Take-Two, and that if/when they are, they'll not comply without first considering the ramifications of doing so.
Read more
articles.title: Discord have yet to receive a GTA 6 leak subpoena from Take-Two, says marketing director, but they will "evaluate the validity and scope" if they do

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Steam's latest head-scratching hangout game (don't call it friendslop, you will rekindle Discourse) is How to Fish, a macabre novelty in which hideous worm people boat out to small cursed islands, reel in angry sealife, and blast the creatures into submission with golden sniper rifles, spending the proceeds on weapons and gadgets. I could be misinterpreting, but I don't think the idea is sincerely to teach you How to Fish.
 
Read more
articles.title: How to Fish is Steam's latest cursed co-op sensation, now updated with private lobbies, eight player support, and anti-griefer measures

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Pretty much since the day Red Dead Redemption 2 was released and they saw its map included Red Dead 1 states New Austin and West Elizabeth, but didn't extend south of the border, modders have been looking to add in their own re-creations of Mexico. There have been a few attempts already, but the latest looks the most detailed yet and is due out in September.
Read more
articles.title: Red Dead Redemption 2: Nuevo Paraiso, the latest Mexico expansion mod for Rockstar's western, releases next month

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Not content with stealing everyone's attention at Gamescom by unveiling a cheeky extra expansion for a decade-old RPG, CD Projekt Red have decided spend their Monday afternoon locking in the year that The Witcher 4 will be coming out. It's set to emerge from a lake full of drowners in 2028.
Read more
articles.title: The Witcher 4 is targeting release in 2028, CD Projekt Red confirm, while teasing that extra Witcher 3 DLC Songs of the Past has a "dark story" in store

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Formidable fantasy soulslike Mortal Shell 2 has been getting it in the shins from certain players over the decision to 'lock them out' of Steam achievements, when they equip the notorious Slayer Seal.
Trailers have characterised the Slayer Seal as an in-game 'easy mode'. As Jeremy summarises in our own Mortal Shell 2 review, it gives "you a pulverising punch and your ranged weapons the ability to deal Break damage", which goes a fair way in an action-RPG this vicious. Not being able to earn achievements with the Seal equipped (or even after you unequip it) has sparked a few Reddit threads protesting that people are being punished for declining to punish themselves… while other people (hello!) wonder why anybody cares this much about Steam achievements at all.
Read more
articles.title: "We ended up kind of cornered there": Mortal Shell 2 devs say they didn't intend to "lock everybody out" by disabling achievements for Slayer Seal "easy mode" users

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Update 25/08: Paradox have officially announced Afterworld with a story trailer - read more about it here.
Our original story continues below.
What is happening across the Paradox Universe? So the publishers behind strategy stalwarts like Crusader Kings 3 and Europa Universalis 4 asked in a post to the socials the other day, which promised all will be revealed on August 25th at Gamescom. Unfortunately for those best laid plans, the name of the game in question looks to have leaked via Paradox's forum of all places. Assuming the leaks prove accurate, it's a post-apocalyptic survival strategiser called Afterworld.
Read more
articles.title: Paradox's next grand strategy game is a post-apocalyptic wasteland tribe-battler called Afterworld, according to leaks ahead of Gamescom

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Hello all! I regret to report that the Maw is in a really good mood this week. Its scales have an almost flirtatious lustre, flashing in and out of visibility as I gaze from my eyrie above north London. Its crimson coral coils and fins of mounded verdigris can be seen reflected in the distant moneytemples of Canary Wharf. Its fractal teeth and hair form expressionist whorls and divots among the haggard late summer clouds.
The Maw is merry because this week is Gamescom week - a time of much videogame news and thus, a time of feasting for extradimensional gods with a hankering for headlines. It also happens to be the week in which Rockstar and Netflix will stream a GTA 6 documentary (27th August), giving rise to many, many articles in the vein of "50 individually rendered breakfast cereal shapes you missed from the all-new Vice City". As if all that wasn't enough, there are a load of uncommonly chunky new PC releases to contend with. Here's my latest list.
 Read more
articles.title: This week in PC games: Gamescom and GTA 6 fight for our attention, but don't forget Folk Emerging, MGS4 and the horror game about balancing a cake

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
It's the start of a new week, and you've got a bad case of the Mondays. Ah, but why do I antagonise you so with these twee and crushingly normative white collar office job cliches? You aren't necessarily working a 9-5, and every day is hard, isn't it? You've got a lot on your mind. You've got a lot on your plate. It seems there's no end to the woe. Rest easy, my friend – no vexation you are feeling can possibly be as vexatious as the Space Invader area in Today's Star Is.
 Read more
articles.title: Haul a star through a labyrinth in Today's Star Is, a challenging free game from the Love Eternal devs with a new level coming every day

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Tamriel Rebuilt, the Morrowind modding project gradually adding the province's mainland to The Elder Scrolls 3's Vvardenfell-centric map, has gotten a fresh expansion over the weekend. Dubbed Poison Song, it's the long-teased update which lets you join House Indoril, the great Dunmer house the Neravarine's namesake Indoril Nevevar belonged to belonged. It'll also let you join the Temple Ordinators, Morrowind's golden-masked lawkeepers, and explore a new region full of "lush gardens and bountiful fields".
Read more
articles.title: Massive Morrowind mod Tamriel Rebuilt's Poison Song expansion is out now, complete with new quests to join Great House Indoril and the Ordinators

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Sometimes, Sundays are only for rounding up videogame criticism and journalism. I try to cast a wider net when my turn comes to deliver the Papers, because I figure you've probably been reading about videogames all week, and would appreciate e.g. an essay on the mating habits of snails or the top 7 most elaborate UFO conspiracies, but this Sunday, there are no snails or UFOs within easy dredge. So instead, please accept a boatload of finest mitherings on Duke Nukem, oracular visual novels, sociable space sims, and 'search action' games.
 Read more
articles.title: The Sunday Papers

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Raising sims aren't a genre I've partaken in, partially because so many of them are geared towards a sort of father, daughter vibe that doesn't quite fit me. Raising a mech pilot, however, seems like something a bit more my speed, so you won't be surprised to hear of my interest in Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator, a visual novel with a name that seems to do what it says in the tin.
 
Read more
articles.title: Raise up a mech pilot and make sure she doesn't get Evangelion-level depressed in the sci-fi visual novel Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Look, I love a PS1 horror throwback as much as the next whatever Gonzo is, but they don't all have to look like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, do they? There have been some aesthetic divergences in the renewed interest in the pseudo-genre, like with 2024's excellent and queer as hell Sorry We're Closed, but I'm hungry for more. Hence my interest in NEHCROMIA, a high-contrast survival horror set in a castle made of memories that aren't yours (a seizure warning is in order for the trailer below).
 
Read more
articles.title: Chromatic aberration is made manifest in NECHROMIA, a high contrast survival horror set in a castle made of something else's memories

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
It's very rare that I'm not thinking about the works of Satoshi Kon (pop on Tokyo Godfathers this Christmas, you won't regret it), but the one that I always come back to is Opus. It's a manga the director made in the mid '90s that he ultimately never finished before his death, following a manga artist who gets sucked into his own creation and forced to deal with the consequences of his writing. Tulpa the Unseen Lover, a psychological visual novel made by former Spider-Verse animators, is sort of like that, only in this case it's about a manga creator bringing an anime girl to life in his mind.
 
Read more
articles.title: Tulpa the Unseen Lover is a psychological visual novel about a depressed manga artist manifesting a cute, ominous anime girl made by former Spider-Verse animators

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Sorry folks, some bad news: Neverway, the horror life sim and RPG combo from one of the artists behind Celeste and the composer of Fez, has been delayed into 2027. While it never had an exact release date anyway, developer Coldblood Inc. shared word of the delay in a Steam blog post earlier this week.
 
Read more
articles.title: Gorgeous and hazy pixel art horror farming sim Neverway has been pushed to 2027, but you can at least have a gander at some of the NPCs you can smooch

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Earlier this week, South of Midnight developer Compulsion Games shared word that they now own all of the publishing rights to their games, a welcome update in light of the ongoing BDS boycott against Microsoft and Xbox. And now, another studio is joining the realm of boycott freedom, this time Psychonauts studio Double Fine, as CEO Tim Schafer has confirmed that they too now own the publishing rights to their own catalogue.
 
Read more
articles.title: "Buying any of our games helps support the studio": Psychonauts studio Double Fine are the latest former Xbox-owned studio to get the rights to their games back

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
For the past ten days or so I've been whinging my way through a chest infection. My partner's been sent out for lemsips, tissues, the blood of a vital youth filled with hopes of a bright future, and chicken soup. With the last dregs of the lurgy coming out of me in runs of coughs I'm starting to feel well again, meaning I've a weekend of ignored chores to catch up on. That and attending a one-year-old's birthday party.
Fingers crossed my immune system is now in fighting form because, with Gamescom next week, it would be right annoying to pick up something else.
Read more
articles.title: What are we all playing this weekend?

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
I've already humiliated myself attempting to describe the sensory enormity that is Cicadamata", the new movement shooter from flowergarden with the tricksy title punctuation, so instead of writing additional sentences such as "this game is like drinking the aurora borealis" (OK, one more) or "this game is like surfing the Niagara Falls during a freak shower of potassium pellets" (enough!), I'm just going to transcribe the latest trailer.
 
Read more
articles.title: Indecently cool FPS platformer Cicadamata" is out now - please get yourself down that rabbit hole

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Before we talk about Sandustry, the excellent new spelunking factory builder from Lantto Games and Hooded Horse, we need to revisit that most quintessentially vidyagame of topics, the post-industrial countryside of Wales. Early on in my recent 105-mile "review" of the MSI Cyborg 14 laptop, I walked through the old slate quarries near the village of Aberllefenni – the longest continually operated slate mining setup in the world until its closure in 2003.
 
Read more
articles.title: Sandustry is the first factory simulation game I've played that gets heaps right

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Well, the chase has begun. Rockstar parent company Take-Two are after the identity of the hacker or hackers behind this week's GTA 6 leak. Having spent a number of days swatting clips with takedowns, while the leakers dumped more and more across the net, Take-Two have filed multiple subpoenas in federal district court asking Microsoft and Discord to share records related to accounts which have been involved in posting and sharing the leaks.
Read more
articles.title: GTA 6 leaker hunt is on, as Rockstar owners Take-Two file subpoenas asking Microsoft and Discord for records

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, the second series of the anime CD Projekt Red and Netflix grafted onto the former's cyberverse following Cyberpunk 2077's release, will premiere on October 20th. Having previously revealed the four new Night City dwellers its plot will be following, the show's creators have now put out another trailer teasing the tale of "revenge and redemption" in store.
Read more
articles.title: "The lines between redemption and revenge will blur", promises Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2's latest trailer as the series locks in a late October release

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Among Shadows is the kind of videogame genre arithmetic that often proves less than the sum of its parts, but I'm cautiously enthused by its talk of disease, betrayal and Elden Ring: Nightreign-flavoured swordwizarding. The gist: this is a fantasy action-RPG with an Among Us-style social deduction element. You are a member of the Order of the Secret Fire, sent into a supernaturally blighted region to track down sources of corruption, while looting gear and levelling yourself up.
 
Read more
articles.title: Among Shadows is a Nightreign-style dark fantasy RPG with a touch of Among Us that makes me think wistfully of Dark Souls at its most treacherous

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
We Happy Few and South of Midnight developers Compulsion Games have announced that they are fully broken up with Microsoft and Xbox, after completing a management buyout. They now once again own the rights to all their own original intellectual properties. Amongst other things, this means that you can buy South of Midnight – summarised by Brendy (RPS in peace) as "a beautiful folkloric tale" and a "plain and unambitious" action-adventure – while still taking part in the BDS boycott against Microsoft's Israeli military connections. When you buy the Steam version of South of Midnight, all your money (after Valve's revenue cut) will go to Compulsion.
 
Read more
articles.title: “We’re going to take things slow": South of Midnight devs now own the rights to all their games again, after quitting Xbox, and are working on a new game

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
While scammers and other ne'er-do-wells leaning into the allure of playing GTA 6 as part of their efforts to spread malware isn't anything new - cybersecurity companies have been issuing warnings about it for months - there appears to have been an uptick in such behaviour following the latest GTA 6 leak. With speculation rampant as to what exactly the hackers known as Cyberleek may have access to, now is not the time to be downloading any files claiming to be GTA 6.
Read more
articles.title: PSA: In the latest GTA 6 leak's aftermath, it's not a good idea to download files with names like totallylegitgta6leakedbuild.exe

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Heavy is the burden of being a game developer, as even as a game launches, there is always still work to be done. Mortal Shell 2 is out today, and while it generally seems to be doing quite well for itself, a game of its ilk, i.e. a Soulslike, doesn't necessarily get everything right the first go around (or I guess second first in this case). So, to smooth out some edges, developer Cold Symmetry have already released the game's first balance patch.
 
Read more
articles.title: Mortal Shell 2's first balance patch makes its in-game economy a lot more lenient and nerfs some enemies and bosses for a smoother ride

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Riot Games' fighting game take on the world of League of Legends, 2XKO, is winding down development. The developer shared word today that active development on the game is ending December this year, citing a lack of a strong enough adoption and retention rate for the fighting game.
 
Read more
articles.title: Active development on League of Legends fighting game spinoff 2XKO will be coming to an end at the end of the year

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
"I wanna see how much abuse gamers can take," a voice over opens the trailer for Sensory Overload, a game that will likely be taking home the Geoff "IMAX" Keighley Award for Most Appropriate Title For A Video Game later this year. It's a simple concept for a game: you are constantly falling, and you must avoid walls in various shapes as you do so to wrack up points. Simple! And disgustingly disorienting.
 
Read more
articles.title: This game inspired by classic Minecraft dropper maps can't work out whether it wants to rapture you or make you throw up

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
It appears that August is the month for having thoughts on the success of immersive sims! Earlier this month, one of the original designers behind Thief: The Dark Project shared his feelings on developing imsims at triple-A scale, coming to the conclusion it doesn't really work. Just yesterday, Arkane veteran and Dishonored director Harvey Smith revealed his new studio that's entirely dedicated to the genre. And now, Smith, alongside fellow leads at the new studio Ben Horne and Ricardo Bare, answers the evergreen question: are imsims dead?
 
Read more
articles.title: "Do questions like that create a self-fulfilling prophecy?”: Dishonored director Harvey Smith on the fear of asking if immersive sims are dead

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Well, here's something that's a bit of a bummer. You'll probably best know Kumi Tanioka as the composer behind Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles, though her work can also be found across the likes of Final Fantasy 11, Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity, and more recently, Yoshi and the Mysterious Book. But lately, it seems like someone's been trying to pass off an entirely AI generated album as her work, much to Tanioka's own confusion.
 
Read more
articles.title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles composer Kumi Tanioka says that she didn't make the new, very likely AI-generated album on her Spotify page

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Lo, a new power rose in the East. The warlord Michael of Jordan united the people of Chicago under the crest of the bull, then with his general Scottie of Pippen and the triangular religion of bishop Phil of Jackson, conquered the whole realm. Alas, those feeble heirs who inherited Michael's fiefdom upon his passing into retirement failed to retain all he'd won, and soon kings named Kobe of Bryant and LeBron of James vied for supremacy. This, I assume, is how a playthrough of NBA 2K27's new MyNBA Legacy mode might go, given it seems to have taken cues from Crusader Kings 3's multi-generation dynasty-crafting.
Read more
articles.title: Hold the throne, NBA 2K27's new MyNBA Legacy mode sounds a lot like basketball Crusader Kings 3

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Game Science have put out a fresh trailer showing off Black Myth: Zhong Kui, their follow-up to Chinese mythology-stuffed action-RPG Black Myth: Wukong, in action. A year on from its reveal at 2025's Gamescom, Zhong Kui's looking as slicey and rolly as its predecessor, despite a switch in protagonist.
Read more
articles.title: Black Myth: Zhong Kui shows off 15 minutes of rollparrysliceage, and I've just learned that the bloke it's named after was a lethally effective headbanger

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
The crypto-peddling hacker group who leaked footage of GTA 6 earlier this week appear to have access to a playable version of Rockstar and Take-Two Interactive's forthcoming open world game, if recent videos are any indication.
 Read more
articles.title: A playable build of GTA 6 appears to have leaked, as Rockstar and Take-Two scramble to take down videos

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
Stories of pirates are full of swashbuckling, daring-do, and grog. But Limbic Entertainment's city builder Corsair Cove reveals those hijinx are only a sideshow: logistics is the star. As the proud owner of a tropical island surrounded by high seas dotted with patrolling Spanish galleons, pirate hunters, and kraken, your focus is squarely on building the infrastructure to support pillaging, rather than taking a firsthand approach to the scallywaggery.
To keep your pirate populace happy, initially they'll only need basic food, drink, and shelter. In time, though, they'll start asking for finer things, like leather boots, jolly roger flags, and turtle soup. All of which you'll need to produce by rinsing the resource deposits on your island. Keep them happy, however, and they will set out on the ocean, crewing your vessels, and risking their lives against the threats that circle your enclave.
As a fan of the Anno series, the first hours of Corsair Cove were enthralling, but the sheen did begin to rub off after eight hours or so. Right about the time my pirates started to hate me.
Read more
articles.title: All of the pirates in Hooded Horse city builder Corsair Cove hate me because I can't make them eyepatches fast enough

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Now the ink's starting to dry on the Saudi Arabian government and Jared Kushner-backed takeover of EA, which has seen the company go private, staff are getting to grips with what the ownership change might mean for them going forwards. Fears of layoffs and teams or game series being sold off following the leveraged buyout hang in the air alongside unease about the effect the Saudi state's values might have on what gets the green light in future, with staff suggesting EA haven't done a very good job of alleviating such concerns.
Read more
articles.title: EA's Saudi takeover wouldn't have happened if the company's culture "had any semblance of a moral backbone", say staff fearing layoffs and ownership meddling

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Horizon Hunters Gathering, the live service multiplayer spin-off for PlayStation's post-apocalyptic Horizon series, is being rebooted as a smaller and more traditional co-op experience with a story mode, according to anonymous insiders. In the process, we're told, several of the project's staff are being reassigned within Sony's gamedev empire, even as a small team of Guerrilla Games work on the next "proper" singleplayer Horizon game.
 
Read more
articles.title: Sony are rebooting their live service Horizon game as a more traditional co-op affair, claim sources, with a proper Horizon Forbidden West sequel still years away

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Belated congratulations to everybody who correctly guessed that Mortal Shell 2 was the mystery game our guides team were raving about a couple of weeks ago. You'll hopefully have read Jeremy's glowing review, in which he calls the new Soulslike RPG "an incredible second outing that capitalises upon the potential of the first Mortal Shell and brings forth nostalgic memories of DOOM, Heretic, Hexen, and other PC gaming gems." Now, let us speak of difficulty thresholds, hotfix patches, and turning the tables on enemies so badassedly that you accidentally pinch their weapons.
 Read more
articles.title: Amid accusations of a post-beta difficulty bump, Mortal Shell 2 devs patch the new soulslike to stop players riposting so hard they steal enemy weapons

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
I don’t begrudge anyone who’s waited to try STALKER 2: Heart of Chornobyl until it got its technical defects fixed. They’re still wrong, obviously - an absorbing and eerily atmospheric survival FPS is still an absorbing and eerily atmospheric survival FPS when it has the structural integrity of baked beans. But it was spectacularly broken at launch, and although nearly two years of patches have swatted countless bugs and beefed up the series’ signature A-Life NPC simulation, it’s remained a heavyweight GPU-puncher on general performance.
Thank the Zone, then, for the 2.0 update, which rolls out tomorrow in tandem with the also-good Cost of Hope expansion. It ambitiously migrates STALKER 2 to a newer, sleeker version of Unreal Engine 5, and makes sweeping (though handcrafted) changes to lighting and environmental deets. Based on what I’ve played, the result is both a better-looking game and a better-performing one. So get in here, stalker - there’s never been a better time to have your skeleton melted out by an anomalous soap bubble.
Read more
articles.title: STALKER 2 gets serious performance and visual upgrades with its 2.0 update, testing confirms, polishing up one of the biggest flawed gems in FPS games

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Days after Deus Ex director Warren Spector announced that he was quitting the business, another former Ion Storm developer, Harvey Smith, has revealed Black Pony Immersive - a new studio dedicated to the creation of "imaginative first-person action RPGs set within well-realized worlds, where players create their own memorable experiences with expressive, emergent game systems." The announcement features the maxim: "through the looking glass, we’re chasing a dream of mystery, meaning, and creative play." Hey, I understood that reference! Sure sounds like an imsim shop to me.
 Read more
articles.title: "Through the looking glass": as Arkane fight for their future, Dishonored veteran Harvey Smith reveals new studio dedicated to immersive sims

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
Like the technical fix-uppery of the 2.0 update it’s launching alongside, STALKER 2: Heart of Chornobyl’s Cost of Hope expansion arrives with a determinedly furrowed brow; that kind of enthusiastic, if just slightly contrite, look of someone hellbent on righting their own past wrongs.
Of course, most of the open-world shooter’s past crimes are long absolved, if not forgiven immediately on the grounds that they were committed amid an actual war. But Cost of Hope does serve as a second chance for this bleak, beautiful, tense, thrilling, imperfectly brilliant game to address certain omissions it made back in 2024 – even if some of these restorations gleam brighter than others.
Read more
articles.title: STALKER 2: Cost of Hope review: An expanded Zone that begs to be explored, even as its faction war fizzles

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Yesterday, August 18th, further union rallies against Microsoft's mass layoffs across Xbox studios were held across North America. As the One Bethesda Game Studio (OneBGS) union and the Communication Workers of America (CWA)-supported protests continue, one unionised Bethesda developer has said that while work-related morale for those who remain at the studio is low, there's optimism about their efforts to organise.
Read more
articles.title: "Without us, Bethesda games aren’t Bethesda games": Rallies against Microsoft layoffs at Elder Scrolls studio continue, with unionised devs' morale "on the upswing"

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Space horror immersive sim RetroSpace will launch on 1st October 2026, developers The Wild Gentlemen and publishers Kwalee have announced. New to RetroSpace? In brief: you are a 3D-printed clone janitor, trapped aboard a space station that has been swallowed by a "sentient black hole". Now, you must deploy a mixture of stealth, violence and swaggering "discopunk" ingenuity as you go up against a bunch of mutant plants and animals, together with the station's own security systems.
 Read more
articles.title: Immersive sim Retrospace, aka '70s System Shock, gets an October release date plus a trailer full of funky guns and sentient black holes

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
As you might have seen, there was another alleged GTA 6 leak yesterday, with apparent footage of Rockstar's crime sandbox in action spread across the net and in many cases swiftly hit with DMCA takedowns. The group seemingly behind the leakage this time have claimed that their motivations have to do with ranging against anti-consumer practices by publishers, prompting the Stop Killing Games campaign to step in and issue a statement condemning and distancing themselves from the hack.
Read more
articles.title: Latest alleged GTA 6 leak "risks tarnishing the reputation of our communities", say Stop Killing Games after hackers claim pro-consumer motivations

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
A thing that always tickles me in a particular way is when a game takes a beloved mechanic from an iconic game that doesn't technically exist. By not existing I'm talking about something like wavedashing in Super Smash Bros. Melee. You can't play that game professionally without doing it, and yet it's just an exploit as opposed to something purposeful, but there are derivatives that directly bake it in. So, despite never playing its source (pun intended (you'll see what I mean in a second)) of inspiration, I'm quite intrigued by Clipmatrix, a momentum platformer set in surreal, industrial locales built around Source Engine bunny hopping found in the likes of Counter-Strike.
 
Read more
articles.title: Clipmatrix is a Counter-Strike-like, bunny hopping, platforming romp through surreal and industrial locales

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Yeah, it's happened again: some GTA 6 bits appear to have leaked. I'm not going to link to any of them for I hope obvious reasons, as well as the fact I don't want John Rockstar to send me an email wagging their virtual finger at me. But, having seen them, they do seem to be legit, consisting of a couple of clips and a handful of screenshots showing the in-game map.
 
Read more
articles.title: GTA 6 footage once again appears to leak online, this time because of a group that wants games like The Crew to have offline modes and the end of digital preorders

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
I was already aware of Entropy before Edwin called it a game that looked like a PS1 game fished from a toilet, primarily thanks to the stellar work developer Lovely Hellplace carried out in their previous game Dread Delusion, but I'm sure that would have hooked me in conceptually just as easily. And now you can dive into this turn-based, post-apocalyptic RPG yourself, as it's launched into early access.
 
Read more
articles.title: Entropy, a deliciously miserable Final Fantasy-esque RPG where your party members can permanently die, is now out in early access

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Another month, another Subnautica 2 update! Last month's focus was on changing creature behaviours to make it a bit less frustrating for those of you that just wanted to go on a killing spree. This month puts the focus on your friends, with the 1.2 update being titled "Buddy System," adding in some neat new features that'll mean you'll have a smoother time playing with your pals.
 
Read more
articles.title: Subnautica 2's Buddy System update brings in the promised proximity chat, easier trading, and emotes so you can sarcastically applaud your friends

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
I've woken up on a beach. I'm staring up into the nostrils of a bald man whose face looks to be made of wet clay. He's saying vaguely threatening things about a tower and my race and an island and the fact I'm far from home. The dialogue camera of The Lantern of the Laughless Saint clearly picks up on how unnerved this introduction to its adventure has made me.
Read more
articles.title: The Lantern of the Laughless Saint, a Morrowind-inspired RPG weirdfest out this week in early access, has immediately seduced me with dialogue camera hijinks

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Marathon's Vault Breaker, an experimental PvE mode that allowed even solo folks to take on the endgame map Cryo Archive, is wrapping up today, but Bungie does at least have a new event for you to have a go at in kind. It's called Ordnance Heist, and while it doesn't offer any major new features or radical changes, the big thing it does focus on is completing multiple runs across multiple maps, netting you an explosive weapon called the Firestorm.
 
Read more
articles.title: Marathon's limited time Ordnance Heist is a multi-run and map event that nets you a cool gun you can't keep

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Recently, RPS has seen a mighty renaissance of train game reporting. Look to east, and you will find James doing locomotive kickflips in Denshattack, a J-pop stunt racer turbocharged by the hope of a better world. Look to west, and you'll witness Julian bopping bandit Pullmen in Fogpiercer, or chuffing gaily between the plumpest asteroids in Profits 2167.
 Read more
articles.title: Trainwatch is a life sim, a horror game, and a time management experience rolled up into a haunting story about the eerie places you see from a speeding carriage

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Former Rockstar staff currently embroiled in a legal battle with the company over their firings last year have asked supporters not to boycott GTA 6, but instead to consider helping cover the costs of their fight against Rockstar by buying specially-designed union merchandise.
Read more
articles.title: Rather than calling for GTA 6 boycott, fired Rockstar workers urge players to support them in their legal battle against the studio by buying union merch

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
In Hello Andromeda's Sarco, you're trapped in a scientific research base with a sarcophagus housing a cosmic being that starts to open when you aren't looking at it. Friends, I am never going to beat this game - not because I dread to gaze into the abyss, lest it gaze into me, nor because as with Schrödinger's cat, I do not credit the sealed cosmic being with a stable existence prior to the box's opening. No, I'm going to fail because my parents taught me that it's rude to stare and they did not add the disclaimer "...unless you're trying to keep the lid on Shub-Niggurath, The Black Goat of the Woods with a Thousand Young."
 Read more
articles.title: Stare at an imprisoned god to stop the apocalypse in Sarco, a no-saves horror game in which you'll also, somehow, have to explore a gutted scientific base

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Nature's relaxing, yeah? Life as a forest ranger, wandering around amid the trees and making sure none of the animals are getting up to mischief sounds a bit like bliss. Unless you're the forest ranger in freshly announced horror game I Hear the Forest, who's been cursed and is thus not having a relaxing time in the woods.
Read more
articles.title: Talking trees, flying witch heads and an unsettling rabbit man await in the shrubbery of cursed woodland ranger sim I Hear the Forest

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
On viewing the trailer for Fog'n'Silence, I transformed instantly into a caricature of a Texan oilman. "Hoowee!!" I whooped, hurling down my ten gallon hat and firing my ivory-handled six shooter into the air. "I have got to get me some of that Fog'n'Silence!!" The best thing about this reference is that it tells you absolutely nothing about Fog'n'Silence.
Created by Kyiv-based Hello Andromeda, this is a grim and enveloping party-based open world RPG that, according to studio co-founder Vlad Muntian, takes inspiration from Kenshi, Death Stranding, and Outer Wilds. It puts you in charge of a group of Vagrants exploring the vast plains of the Afterlife. You'll deal with transmogrifying fog, sneak around blind monsters, tackle esoteric physics, and (if you must) take part in freeze-time combat that sees Vagrants and adversaries plotting actions, then playing them out simultaneously. All the while dealing with lasting injuries, mounting hunger, and rapidly decreasing sanity.
 Read more
articles.title: Death Stranding meets party-based tactical combat in open world RPG Fog'n'Silence, in which you lead twisted humans through the Afterlife

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Warren Spector, Deus Ex director and general household name of the PC gamingverse, has announced his retirement from game development. Though, he's not completely closed the door on making a comeback down the line, alluding to three games in particular that he'd still like to make if the right circumstances popped up.
Read more
articles.title: Deus Ex director and immersive sim legend Warren Spector is retiring, despite having "three games in particular" he'd still like to make

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
US senators have launched an investigation of game creation platform Roblox on a broad charge of putting money before child safety. They accuse Roblox of being a venue for "sexually explicit (and often violent) virtual 'experiences' with children", and have requested a range of documents and records, including details of the company's collaborations with Sesame Street, the NFL and FIFA.
 Read more
articles.title: The US Senate are investigating Roblox for prioritising "revenue and engagement metrics over the safety and well-being of our children"

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Right, just a couple more location overhauls and there we go. A fresh Skyrim load order created for my first modded toe-dip into Tamriel for quite a while, outside of grabbing the odd article image. Phew, now to relax and sink another 50 hou-wait. Fallout 4 and Skyrim updates are inbound, say Bethesda? Well, that would be my luck, wouldn't it?
Read more
articles.title: I'm not saying Bethesda are trolling me specifically, but Fallout 4 and Skyrim updates are imminent just as I've modded up the latter for the first time in ages

articles.author: Jeremy Blum
articles.description:
A few hours into your sojourn across Mortal Shell 2's harsh realm of Fainweald, you might stumble upon a tavern called The One Legged Wolf. In a monstrous land inhabited by pasty-faced brigands who refer to you as "brev" right before shanking you, this watering hole exudes novelty. Here, said thugs congregate to make merry and listen to the strums of the shirtless lute-player on stage. Even if you do as I did, and accidentally massacre the guy with a shot from your sidearm, nobody minds. The One Legged Wolf is a weird, memorable place where folk are free to do their own thing.
In many ways, The One Legged Wolf is emblematic of Mortal Shell 2, a sequel that stands out from the pack by melding the modern dark fantasy Soulslike with a willingness to ditch genre formula, a cheeky sense of humour, and the DNA of a PC-only game from yesteryear. The result is a goth cousin of more mainstream fare like Elden Ring, not to mention a phenomenal effort that outclasses its predecessor in a manner that we probably haven't seen since The Witcher III.
Read more
articles.title: Mortal Shell 2 review: A monumental heavy metal sequel with the spirit of a '90s PC game

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Fetch your finest presentation materials about lines on graphs going upwards and proceed to try and beat your colleagues to death with them. Stick It to the Stickman, the roguelite beat ’em up which Anger Foot devs Free Lives have been bashing into shape for a year and a bit is set to emerge from early access on September 23rd.
Read more
articles.title: Boardroom beat-em-up Stick It to the Stickman punches its way out of early access next month, complete with neurolinkage and an "absolutely absurd finale"

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Monika Kutějová)
articles.description: Podíváme se na útok na Hugging Face koordinovaný stovkami agentů AI, na zatčení údajných členů skupiny TeamPCP v Austrálii, kyberútok na Boston Scientific, phishing na přístupové kódy k iPhone a zřetězené zranitelnosti v SharePointu.
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: útok na Hugging Face koordinovalo přes 700 agentů AI

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Projekt Asahi Linux se výrazně přiblížil k oficiální podpoře počítačů Apple s čipy M3. Společnost X zaslala projektu Nitter, open-source alternativnímu rozhraní pro síť X, výzvu k ukončení činnosti.
articles.title: Asahi je blízko oficiální podpory M3, společnost X žaluje klienta Nitter

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Ověřování věku v Kalifornii ne na úrovni samotného Linuxu, otázkou jsou polouzavřené systémy, týden v KDE opět o Plasmě 6.8 a také QtWidgets aplikacích, týden v GNOME ve znamení Flatpaků. Spor století o záměrném budování závislosti dětí na Facebooku / Instagramu končí mimosoudní dohodou, Zuckerberg se vykoupil.
articles.title: Facebook se dohodl a zaplatí odškodné 18 miliard USD, do Flatpaku míří půl miliónu eur

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Letošní srpnové vydání LibreOffice, výrazně zlepšuje formátování textů ve Writeru, podporu souborů z MS Excelu, přináší aktualizované vzory pro prezentace i vylepšení podpory skriptování a spoustu dalších novinek.
articles.title: LibreOffice 26.8: nejen odstavcový sazeč značně vylepšující formátování textu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Navážeme na článek o vývoji pro osmibitové mikropočítače Atari a ukážeme si použití slavného assembleru MAC/65, což po dlouhou dobu byl nejlepší assembler pro mikroprocesory MOS 6502.
articles.title: Makro assembler MAC/65 a debugger DDT v praxi

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Sonda do světa otevřeného softwaru. Dnes vyzkoušíme e-mailového klienta pro GNOME, podíváme se na další hudební přehrávač, řekneme si o nativním linuxovém klientu pro Nextcloud a taky o klientu pro sociální síť Mastodon.
articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (26. 8. 2026): udělejte si pořadek v poště

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Vývoj aplikací pro počítače Atari s využitím cross assembleru CA65 není příliš komplikovaný. Vývoj totiž provádíme na PC se všemi jeho možnostmi. Pokusme se vrátit o 45 let zpět a použít Atari Assembler/Editor.
articles.title: Jak probíhal vývoj pro osmibitová Atari před 45 lety?

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: ČD - Telematika)
articles.description: V dnešním díle se podíváme na zneužití zranitelnosti v GitLab, útoky na kritickou infrastrukturu USA, íránský útok na americké univerzity a platby prošlými Visa kartami
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: kritická infrastruktura USA čelí útokům na řídicí systémy

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Společnost Pine64 kvůli současnému nedostatku pamětí DRAM a eMMC dočasně pozastavuje výrobu linuxových zařízení. Tuxedo OS mění způsob aktualizace linuxového jádra. Redox OS výrazně vylepšil svůj grafický instalátor.
articles.title: PINE64 omezuje výrobu, Tuxedo OS mění přístup k linuxovému jádru

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: KDE zefektivňuje budoucí Plasmu 6.8 a přidává podporu pro Btrfs snapshoty, vylepšení pro 3dfx Voodoo 3+4+5, podpora pro blížící se Intel Nova Lake již stabilní.
articles.title: Lepší podpora 3dfx či Atari Falcon, Wine řešící PMD 85

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Vývojáři Debianu měli dva týdny na hlasování o kódu vytvořeném velkými jazykovými modely. Rozhodovalo se mezi osmi variantami a hlasování skončilo v pátek. Vyhrálo odpovědné používání umělé inteligence, což je návrh číslo 5 (E).
articles.title: Vývojáři Debianu odhlasovali odpovědné používání umělé inteligence

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Btrfs v jádře 7.3 dostalo několik vylepšení a můžeme se těšit na větší výkon. Server Phoronix testoval, jak jsou na tom souborové systémy Btrfs, EXT4, F2FS a XFS v jádře 7.2 a 7.3.
articles.title: Btrfs je v jádře 7.3 v průměru o 23 % rychlejší

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Rychlý kompresní algoritmus Zstd se v jádře využívá na několika místech, například pro transparentní kompresi dat Zswap, Zram, SquashFS, EROFS, Btrfs a F2FS. V současnosti se nejprve zjistí, jestli x86 podporuje instrukce BMI2 (od Intel Haswell a AMD Excavator) a pokud ano, použijí se místo generických instrukcí x86.
articles.title: Zstd v jádře dramaticky zrychluje na x86

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Včera vyšlo Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS. Jde o první opravné vydání Ubuntu 26.04, které vyšlo letos v dubnu. Opravena je spousta chyb, jak v balíčcích, tak v instalátoru. K dispozici jsou také nové obrazy.
articles.title: Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Distribuce Asahi Linux je téměř připravena oficiálně podporovat počítače Mac s čipy M3 od společnosti Apple a v současné době již běží práce na podpoře novějších modelů M4 a M5. Pokročily práce na podpoře různých režimů USB-C (včetně Thunderboltu a DisplayPortu), podpora GPU a dalších součástí.
articles.title: Asahi Linux je připraven brzy uvést podporu pro čipy Apple M3

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Vývojáři vydali Armbian 26.8, který přináší rozsáhlou modernizaci platformy i nástrojů pro instalaci. Největší novinkou je přepracovaný armbian-install s podporou SPI/MTD bootování, samostatného zápisu bootloaderu a přehlednějšími postupy pro eMMC, NVMe, UEFI i dual-boot.
articles.title: Armbian 26.8 přináší přepracovaný instalátor a Imager 2.0

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: gutscfd)
articles.description: Byla zveřejněna první veřejná verze programu GUTS 1.3.43, třírozměrného multiphysics solveru napsaného v C a paralelizovaného pomocí OpenMP. Projekt vznikl postupným rozšiřováním programu TYCHO 1.3.0, který vycházel z hydrodynamického kódu VH-1.
articles.title: Vyšel GUTS 1.3.43, open-source 3D multiphysics solver v C/OpenMP

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Očekávané letní vydání kancelářského balíku LibreOffice verze 26.8 je na světě. Tvůrci vyzdvihují rychlejší otvírání velmi rozsáhlých dokumentů ve Writeru, dokončení infrastruktury pro porovnávání dokumentů ve Writeru vedle sebe, přidání příkazu míchání do randomizace pořadí buněk v daném rozsahu či podporu přepínání mezi zoomem a scrollováním u kolečka myši v editoru Draw.
articles.title: Nová verze LibreOffice 26.8 nejen s rychlejším načítáním rozsáhlých dokumentů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Je tomu 35 let od chvíle, kdy finský student Linus Torvalds oznámil vlastní operační systém. Nic velkého jako Minix, jen takový systémeček pro zábavu, ze kterého vlastně nikdy nic velkého být nemělo.
articles.title: Linux oslavil 35 let

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Vývojáři Googlu pracující na prohlížeči Chrome, resp. jeho svobodném základu Chromium, se pustili do hrátek s balíčkováním prohlížeče ve formě Flatpaků. Jedním dechem ale hned dodejme, že toto není v tuto chvíli cesta k oficiálním Flatpak verzím někde na Flathubu či podobně, jde o zkoumání možností a limitů nabízení prohlížeče v této podobě. Kdo po Flatpakové verzi touží, již komunitní balíčky Chrome i Chromia na Flathubu dávno má.
articles.title: Chromium / Chrome experimentuje s Flatpakem

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Projekt QEMU byl zasažen více než stovkou hlášení chyb od jednoho uživatele během pouhých 10 minut. Hlášení jsou strojová, nenesou žádné známky lidské práce, ignorují daná pravidla, nenavrhují žádná řešení hlášených chyb a už jen nutnost se jimi probrat je velkým zatížením pro vývojáře. Daniel P. Berrangé doslova hovoří o DoS útoku na správce projektu.
articles.title: AI hlášení chyb jako DoS útok na správce open-source projektů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Příští verze linuxového jádra přinese podporu spousty dosud nepodporovaného zvukového „železa“. Plyne to z balíku kódu, který do příslušné vývojové větve jádra posílá správce zvukového subsystému, Takashi Iwai ze Suse.
articles.title: Nově podporovaný zvukový hardware v linuxovém jádru verze 7.3

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Plány pro prohlížeč Firefox na nejbližší období jsou jasné: zatímco obrazový formát JPEG XL lze „experimentálně“ provozovat už od Firefoxu 152, s podporou ve výchozím nastavení se počítá pro vydání verze 157. Tato verze bude vydána ke konci září, tedy zhruba za měsíc. JPEG XL v ní bude aktivován pro všechny podporované platformy.
articles.title: JPEG XL ve Firefoxu 157, zní plán Mozilly

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Jak jsme již informovali, poslední aktualizace Windows 11 rozbíjí některé hry. Na vině je patrně ovladač, který obstarává některá zařízení s RGB osvětlením.
articles.title: Microsoft má dočasné řešení problémů s pádem her po aktualizaci

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Nezávislý americký think tank Pew Research Center minulý týden ve čtvrtek zveřejnil výsledky svého výzkumu o webových stránkách napsaných s pomocí AI. Využívají k tom vlastní nástroj Open Pangram.
articles.title: Více než třetina webových stránek je v současnosti psaná s pomocí AI

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Canonical pokračuje v podpoře Rustu. Nyní bude financovat PhD studenta na univerzitě v Bristolu po dobu tří let. Ten bude ve skupině programovacích jazyků pracovat na nástroji, který vezme velký repozitář v C a automaticky ho převede do Rustu.
articles.title: Canonical financuje doktorát pro automatický převod z C do Rustu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Patrik Žák)
articles.description: Bezpečnostní výzkumníci ze společnosti Patchstack zveřejnili kritickou zranitelnost v pluginu Elementor Pro, což je jeden z nejrozšířenějších editorů stránek pro WordPress. Chyba má označení CVE-2026-32475 s hodnocením CVSS 9.0 umožňuje zcela neautentizovanému útočníkovi nahrát prostřednictvím běžného webového formuláře PHP soubor a následně jej na serveru spustit. Jedná se o učebnicový příklad vzdáleného spuštění kódu (RCE).
articles.title: Kritická zranitelnost v Elementor Pro mění kontaktní formulář v RCE

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Srpnová aktualizace Windows 11 24H2 a 25H2 způsobuje problémy s hrami ARC Raiders, MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls a The Finals. Hry buď zamrzají, padají, objevují se chyby EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION a dochází také k nečekaným restartům celého počítače.
articles.title: Aktualizace Windows 11 rozbíjí některé hry

Využil k tomu také AI, které vykonávalo černou práci. Často se však stalo, že AI řekla, že to je neřešitelný problém a že to má prostě nahlásit.

articles.description: Finanční skupina Partners se stala minulou neděli obětí kybernetického útoku, při kterém se útočníci dostali k některým osobním údajům klientů. Společnost o tom informovala ve čtvrtek. Ujišťuje, že peníze klientů nejsou v ohrožení. „Kybernetický útok zasáhl část IT infrastruktury naší společnosti. Ihned po zjištění útoku jsme s pomocí externích bezpečnostních odborníků začali intenzivně pracovat na minimalizaci škod. Útočníci se však bohužel dostali k osobním údajům klientů Partners Financial Services,“ uvedla skupina v e-mailu, který ve čtvrtek obdrželi její klienti. Zasaženy byly Partners Financial Services, pojišťovna Simplea, penzijní společnost Rentea, Partners investiční společnost a slovenská Simplea Financial Services. Samotnou Partners Banku ani její bankovní systémy útok nezasáhl [Novinky.cz, 𝕏].

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Americká technologická společnost Meta Platforms se dohodla, že zaplatí až zhruba 18 miliard dolarů (asi 373 miliard Kč) za mimosoudní urovnání sporu o závislosti dětí na sociálních sítích a provede významné změny pro jejich používání mladistvými. Téměř tři desítky států USA firmu v roce 2023 obvinily z toho, že sítě Facebook a Instagram vědomě navrhla tak, aby u dětí vyvolávaly závislost, a zatajovala tyto dopady před veřejností. Firma se stala rovněž terčem obvinění z neoprávněného shromažďování a využívání osobních údajů dětí používajících její platformy.
